items.name: api-docs
items.title: API docs
items.description: Interactive API reference at /docs, generated from your OpenAPI document (Scalar).

items.name: api-keys
items.title: API keys
items.description: Personal and service API keys with scopes for scripts and integrations: shown once, SHA-256 at rest, checksummed so secret scanners and typo checks work, expiry, last used, admin revoke, devtools panel. Zero dependencies.

items.name: audit-log
items.title: Audit log
items.description: Who changed what and when: every create, update and delete with a field-level diff (private fields never recorded). Admin API included.

items.name: feature-flags
items.title: Feature flags
items.description: Feature flags in MongoDB: kill switches, deterministic gradual rollouts, per user and per role targeting, weighted variants, ctx.flags in code, route gates, an admin API, a frontend endpoint and a devtools panel.

items.name: idempotency
items.title: Idempotency keys
items.description: Safe retries for POST, PATCH, PUT and DELETE: the Idempotency-Key header (IETF draft) replays the stored response instead of running an operation twice. Per user keys, 409 while running, 422 on reuse, 5xx never stored.

items.name: jobs
items.title: Background jobs
items.description: Background jobs and cron on MongoDB (no Redis): retries with backoff, schedules, event triggers, admin API and a devtools panel.

items.name: magic-link
items.title: Magic link sign-in
items.description: Passwordless sign-in by email: single use links stored hashed, 15 minute expiry, per email cooldown, redirect allowlist, links bound to the browser that asked. Lockout, disabled accounts and 2FA (totp) still apply.

items.name: mail-resend
items.title: Email via Resend
items.description: Deliver emails (password resets, notifications) through the Resend HTTP API. No SDK, just fetch.

items.name: mail-smtp
items.title: Email via SMTP
items.description: Deliver emails through any SMTP server (SES, Postmark, Mailgun, your own) with Nodemailer.

items.name: mcp-server
items.title: MCP server
items.description: Expose your resources to AI agents as Model Context Protocol tools (Streamable HTTP at /mcp). Every call goes through the same policies, validation and serialization as the REST API.

items.name: notifications
items.title: Notifications (inbox, push, email)
items.description: One call, every channel: ctx.notify(user, 'order-shipped', { order }) writes the in-app inbox, sends a push and an email, following each user's preferences and quiet hours. Types are small files in app/notifications/.

items.name: privacy
items.title: Privacy: export and delete
items.description: Data portability and the right to be forgotten: users download everything they own as JSON and delete their account; per resource delete, anonymize or keep; admin routes for support requests; optional grace period.

items.name: push-expo
items.title: Push notifications via Expo
items.description: Deliver app.push notifications to Expo push tokens (Expo and React Native apps) through the Expo push service, as Expo documents it: batching, throttling, retries and push receipts. Works next to push-fcm.

items.name: push-fcm
items.title: Push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging
items.description: Deliver app.push notifications to native Android, iOS and web tokens through the FCM HTTP v1 API, signed with your service account using node:crypto. No SDK. Works next to push-expo.

items.name: rate-limit-mongo
items.title: Shared rate limits (MongoDB)
items.description: Store rate limit counters in MongoDB so limits hold across every instance of your API.

items.name: realtime-sse
items.title: Realtime (SSE)
items.description: Live resource changes over Server-Sent Events, filtered per subscriber with the same policies, scopes and field visibility as the REST API.

items.name: soft-delete
items.title: Soft delete
items.description: Opt-in soft delete per resource: DELETE marks records deleted, queries hide them, admins can list and restore them.

items.name: storage-local
items.title: Local file storage
items.description: File uploads to local disk: a 'file' resource, type and size allowlists, magic-byte checks and safe downloads.

items.name: storage-s3
items.title: S3 file storage
items.description: Direct-to-S3 uploads with presigned URLs (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO): a 'file' resource, type and size allowlists, verified completion and private downloads.

items.name: totp
items.title: Two-factor authentication (TOTP)
items.description: Authenticator-app codes (RFC 6238) on login: setup with an otpauth URL, hashed single-use recovery codes, replay protection, attempt limits. Zero dependencies.

items.name: webhooks
items.title: Webhooks
items.description: Outgoing webhooks for resource events: Standard Webhooks signatures, a MongoDB delivery queue with retries and a delivery log, per-user visibility, SSRF protection and secret rotation. Zero dependencies.
